import nbformat
from nbclient import NotebookClient
from nbconvert import HTMLExporter
from pathlib import Path

infile = Path('FS-Filters.ipynb')
outfile = Path('/results/FS-Filters.html')
nb = nbformat.read(infile, as_version=4)
client = NotebookClient(nb, timeout=None, kernel_name='python3', allow_errors=True)
executed = client.execute()
html_exporter = HTMLExporter()
(body, resources) = html_exporter.from_notebook_node(executed)
outfile.write_text(body, encoding='utf-8')
print('saved', outfile)
